# boss bars and command storage
BOSSBAR other:three {Name:"Three",Visible:1b}
BOSSBAR smoke:one {Color:"red",Max:60,Name:"One",Overlay:"notched_10",Players:[[I;-1217574189,-1929301680,-1288476465,-1272613004],[I;-196291187,2030186727,-1948358755,2017388081]],Value:25}
BOSSBAR smoke:two {Name:"Second",Players:[[I;-196291187,2030186727,-1948358755,2017388081]],Visible:1b}
STORAGE smoke:s {a:1,b:[1,2,3,4],c:{d:"text",e:1.5d,g:{h:[{i:1},{i:2}]}},f:2b}
STORAGE other:t {z:1L}
STORAGE smoke:empty {}
# selector order: nearest, furthest, limits, type and distance filters, the player selectors, an error
SELECT @e[sort=nearest] A 0.5,-60,0.5 -> A Near Mid B Far2 Far
SELECT @e[sort=furthest] A 0.5,-60,0.5 -> Far Far2 B Mid Near A
SELECT @e[sort=nearest,type=pig] B 6.5,-60,0.5 -> Mid Near Far2
SELECT @e[sort=nearest,limit=2] - 10,-60,10 -> Far Mid
SELECT @e[sort=furthest,limit=2,type=pig] - 10,-60,10 -> Near Far2
SELECT @e[sort=nearest,distance=..6] - 0,-60,0 -> A Near
SELECT @e[sort=nearest,distance=3..] - 0,-60,0 -> B Mid Far2 Far
SELECT @e[sort=nearest,type=!pig] - 0,-60,0 -> A B Far
SELECT @a A 0.5,-60,0.5 -> A B
SELECT @p A 0.5,-60,0.5 -> A
SELECT @p B 20,-60,20 -> B
SELECT @s A 0.5,-60,0.5 -> A
SELECT @s Near 0.5,-60,0.5 -> Near
SELECT @n - 0,-60,0 -> A
SELECT @n[type=pig] - 12,-60,2 -> Far2
SELECT @e[sort=nearest,team=red] - 0,-60,0 -> A
SELECT @e[sort=nearest,team=!red] - 0,-60,0 -> Near B Mid Far2 Far
SELECT @e[sort=nearest,scores={dum=5..}] - 0,-60,0 -> A
SELECT @e[sort=nearest,tag=nothing] - 0,-60,0 ->
SELECT @e[sort=banana] - 0,-60,0 -> !Invalid or unknown sort type 'banana'
SELECT @e[limit=0] - 0,-60,0 -> !Limit must be at least 1
SELECT Near - 0,-60,0 ->
SELECT nobody - 0,-60,0 ->
